scope_note: Selected decision reviews for §7.3.10 font metric value consumers; no blanket recertification of font clauses or ADRs.

source_corrections.finding: The primary-page #106 StrikeOut (physical p.329 / printed p.314) removes the Table 109 FontDescriptor row phrase that it shall be an indirect reference. The separate standard-14 all-or-none paragraph is struck by #47/#48 on that page. The corrected source permits a direct FontDescriptor under Table 109; §9.6.3 applies the same entries to TrueType fonts subject to its listed differences.
source_corrections.disposition: The simple-font draft includes a direct-descriptor case and does not treat a direct descriptor as malformed. The stream named by FontFile2 remains indirect because streams are required to be indirect objects.

decisions.topic: Font dictionaries written inline during archive transformation
decisions.review: The ADR uses §7.3.10 direct/indirect equivalence to explain where a converter traverses and materializes font dictionaries. It is about transform traversal, including the descriptor/program route; it does not test display-time resolution of array members in /Widths, /W, /W2, or /DW2.
decisions.disposition: Retain its stated transform decision. Do not cite it as proof of metric-array reader assertions.

decisions.topic: Writing a direct font dictionary out as an object during transformation
decisions.review: The ADR's direct/indirect equivalence rationale concerns a font dictionary embedded in resources and transform output. It does not establish the selected nested metric-value consumers' assertion coverage.
decisions.disposition: Retain its bounded transformation rationale; this shard adds a separate reader-side assertion candidate.

decisions.topic: Preserving dictionary-stated metrics when a glyph program is refused
decisions.review: This ADR is directly relevant to the simple-font test seam: LoadedFont::metrics_only exists to consume dictionary-stated advances without relying on a glyph program. The scratch fixture uses that public API and literal source values, so an embedded/substituted program cannot mask whether Widths and MissingWidth were read.
decisions.disposition: Retain; the proposed direct/indirect variants provide a narrow regression for the values this public metrics-only path reads.

limits: The two draft tests were not compiled or executed by this shard.
Differences name-reference equivalence has visible code support but was not promoted to a defect or third test.

The CID fixture uses the embedded Liberation Sans font's actual hmtx widths for GID/CID 5 and 6 (727/2048 and 1139/2048 em); W and DW match those values. W2/DW2 are independent explicit vertical metric statements.
